assessment.summary: This paper is a narrative mini-review focusing on voltage-gated sodium channel mutations and pyrethroid resistance in Aedes aegypti. It does not contain primary empirical data on African Anopheles field populations.
exclusion_reasons: Not an Anopheles study (focuses on Aedes aegypti)
No primary extractable genotype data for target markers
No primary African field population data
